jsonld_raw.name: (150 G) VIBRANT ROSE SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made with vegetable waxes.

Vibrant Rose | A magnificent contrast of light and shadow, sensuality and magic, like a night in a rose garden. The elegance of the centifolia rose is enhanced by a magnetic touch of patchouli and addictive vanilla. A fragrance that awakens desire and mystery.

Top notes: strawberry, raspberry, cassis, pink grapefruit.
Heart notes: cherry, centifolia rose.
Base notes: patchouli, musk, vanilla.
